headline.purpose: Section headings (.fa-h2), internal console stat values.

subtitle.purpose: Secondary emphasis between title and body, e.g. card kicker lines.

body.purpose: Default running text and form values.

label.purpose: Uppercase section kickers in Vermelho Vital.

caption.purpose: Small supporting text under media, form hints.

micro.purpose: Smallest legible text — badges, dense meta rows.

compactTitle.purpose: Page heading variant for denser internal screens.

value.purpose: Prominent numeric/status values, e.g. stat tiles and prices.

mono.purpose: Prices, order codes, pickup codes — a precision signal.

motion.name: ease-modal
motion.purpose: Modal entrance, slightly overshooting for warmth.

motion.name: superpromo-pulse
motion.purpose: The one deliberately loud animation — reserved for superpromoção badges; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default CTA — Vermelho Vital fill with a red-tinted glow shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 13px 20px; background: #A11017; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -8px #A11017; transition: transform .12s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #890E14; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFD5D5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Vital Button
components.description: Urgent/promotional CTA — vital-accent fill, brightens on hover instead of deepening.
components.css: .ds-btn-vital { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 13px 20px; background: #E03131; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -8px #E03131; transition: filter .15s ease, transform .12s ease; } .ds-btn-vital:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-btn-vital:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.99); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action — transparent fill, Vermelho Vital outline and text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1.5px solid #A11017; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 13px 20px; background: transparent; color: #A11017; transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #FFECEC; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — Rosé Cuidado focus glow matches the search bar and favorites treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #6B5757; } .ds-input { height: 46px; border: 1px solid #E8E1DF; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14.5px; color: #2B1A1A; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #746868; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #A11017; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #FFECEC; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter/category chip — pill-shaped, fills solid Vermelho Vital when active.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 9px 15px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #E8E1DF; background: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: #6B5757; cursor: pointer; transition: all .14s; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #FFD5D5; color: #A11017; } .ds-chip-active { background: #A11017; color: #fff; border-color: #A11017; }

components.name: Superpromoção Badge
components.description: The one deliberately loud, pulsing component — reserved for genuine best-of-the-best deals.
components.css: .ds-superbadge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E03131, #A11017); color: #fff; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: -.01em; padding: 5px 10px 5px 7px; border-radius: 999px; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(224,49,49,.45); animation: dsSuperPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes dsSuperPulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.07); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-superbadge { animation: none; } }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Standard catalog card — soft lift and Rosé border on hover.
components.html:
EMS
Dipirona Monohidratada 500mg, 20 comprimidos
R$ 12,90
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #E8E1DF; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; transition: transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease, border-color .16s; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(43,26,26,.07), 0 2px 6px rgba(43,26,26,.05); border-color: #FFD5D5; } .ds-card-brand { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #746868; } .ds-card-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.28; color: #2B1A1A; } .ds-card-price { font-weight: 800; font-size: 19px; color: #2B1A1A; letter-spacing: -.01em; }

components.name: Internal Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: The one place Vermelho Vital becomes a full-surface fill rather than an accent — white text at rest, solid white pill when active.
components.css: .ds-navlink { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 11px 12px; border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.82); cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s, color .14s; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-navlink:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: #fff; } .ds-navlink-active { background: #fff; color: #A11017; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
Farmaura is a real, single neighborhood pharmacy that also wants to feel like the biggest, most complete pharmacy in its region — and the visual system carries that tension deliberately. Instead of the generic sterile blue/green most pharmacy software defaults to, Farmaura's own tokens are named in the source itself: Vermelho Vital (confident red primary), the vital accent (a brighter red reserved for urgency and promotions), Rosé Cuidado (a soft, caring pink used for hover states and gentle emphasis), Off-white Clínico (a warm off-white background, not sterile white), Bege Atalho (a warm beige for quick-access tiles), and Grafite Quente (a warm charcoal ink instead of pure black). A literal --fa-aura token (0-1 intensity) drives soft decorative arcs and halos behind key surfaces — the brand's own name made into a visual device, not just a wordmark.

The system is shared, not duplicated: internal.css intentionally imports after marketplace.css and reuses its custom properties rather than redefining them, so the pharmacist console and the customer marketplace are two applications of one warm-apothecary language, not two identities. Components favor confident warmth over sterile precision: soft, generous corner radii, gentle hover lifts, pill-shaped chips and badges, and exactly one deliberately loud, pulsing animation reserved for the single moment the interface should feel urgent.
keyCharacteristics: Red trust (Vermelho Vital) as the one recurring brand color, never diluted into a generic blue/green pharmacy palette.
A caring, soft rosé (Rosé Cuidado) as the default hover/focus 'care' color, distinct from the brighter vital accent.
A literal decorative --fa-aura glow/arc layer as the brand's signature atmospheric device.
Soft, low, warm-tinted shadows (never pure black) — depth is ambient, not dramatic.
One shared token system across two segregated surfaces (marketplace + internal), never two competing systems.
Tokens are plain CSS custom properties with fixed defaults (radius scale, density, aura intensity, heading font) — no runtime theme switcher.

rules.name: The No-Sterile-Palette Rule
rules.body: Never introduce the generic pharmacy blue/green as a primary or accent color. Primary and vital red are the only two brand hues; every other color is a warm neutral or a semantic status color.

rules.name: The Two-Reds Rule
rules.body: Primary (#A11017, trust, default) and vital (#E03131, urgency, promotions) are never interchangeable — never use both roles from one color.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Nunito Sans carries the entire hierarchy; don't introduce a second display face. Montserrat and Manrope are loaded but unused — treat them as legacy, not available.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted from Grafite Quente (rgba(43,26,26,...)), never pure black.

rules.name: The Proportional Icon-Tile Rule
rules.body: Compact square icon containers below the fixed scale's own range (roughly 20-44px boxes) are rounded to about 25-30% of their own box size rather than reusing rounded.btn/rounded.card verbatim, because the fixed radius scale was designed around buttons/inputs/cards, not icon containers smaller than an input.

dos: Do keep primary and vital role-separated: trust/default vs. urgency/promotion.
Do use the Rosé Cuidado glow (box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--fa-rose-soft)) as the one focus/hover 'care' signal across inputs, search, and favorited states.
Do scale radius, density, and aura intensity through their single dial tokens instead of hand-tuning individual components.
Do reuse marketplace.css's tokens and the shared UI kit from the internal console rather than redefining equivalents.
Do tint every shadow from Grafite Quente; never use a neutral/black shadow default.
donts: Don't introduce the generic pharmacy blue/green as a primary or accent color.
Don't use the superpromoção pulse animation for anything other than genuine best-of-the-best deals.
Don't reference Montserrat or Manrope as active design fonts — Nunito Sans is the real body/display face.
Don't treat the marketplace and internal surfaces as separate design systems.
